method: Hand-authored editable SVG with pearl/lilac gradients, curved edge lighting, layered warm gold rim and restrained static reflection/glint paths. Development-only resvg-py 0.5.0 / resvg 0.48.1, 2x export. Genuine Unreal texture commandlet import, sRGB UI compression/group, bilinear, no mips/streaming. No imagegen or supplied-reference pixel extraction/editing; QA crops/samples are diagnostics only.
native: Full export UVs and existing .195 horizontal/.45 vertical nine-slice margins. Existing responsive reference slot beneath live label/bulb/native button, enabled-state tint, hover/press overlays and focus behavior. No production geometry, text or learning/input handler change.

fallback_chain.native: ordinary live fill/outline, label and separate bulb

limits: Eight opaque-face samples improve locally but do not establish whole-material fidelity. Rim/bevel, reflection detail, shadow/fringe and existing live type/placement differences remain. Full UI01, motion, device, manual accessibility, editorial, isolated offline, performance and release gates remain open.
